name: PRIMU
definition: A post-hoc uncertainty estimation (UE) framework for Gaussian Splatting that constructs primitive-level representations of error and visibility/coverage from training views, renders them to produce uncertainty feature maps, and aggregates them via pixel-wise regression on holdout data to estimate uncertainties for novel views.
summary: PRIMU is a post-hoc uncertainty estimation framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses 13 primitive-level features to estimate errors without requiring model retraining.
